locators.passage: Entry identifies кто as an interrogative substantive pronoun asking “какой человек, какое существо?” and provides case forms.
Entry identifies что as an interrogative substantive pronoun asking about an object, attribute, or action.
Entry labels где an interrogative adverb and gives location-related interrogative use.
Entry defines куда as asking “в какое место? в каком направлении?” and supplies examples.
Entry defines когда as asking about the time when an action or state occurs.
Dictionary entry for почему: “по какой причине, вследствие чего”.
Entry defines interrogative как as “каким образом” and includes “Как это случилось?”
Entry defines сколько as asking for a quantitative characterization and gives “Сколько стоит эта вещь?”.

claimAssessments.finding: Los pasajes indicados respaldan la afirmación acotada.
